items.title: VEEV Q2 Deep Dive: AI Expansion, CRM Wins, and Accelerating R&D Cloud Adoption
items.summary: Life sciences cloud software provider Veeva Systems (NYSE:VEEV) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 17.6% year on year to $928 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $933.5 million at the midpoint, 1.5% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.35 per share was 5.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
